intro: I’m Evie Hou, a Sociology PhD student. I study social opinions and survey simulation, and develop AI learning tools.
approach: I learn new methods through implementation and use prototypes to test ideas.
role: Third-year Sociology PhD student at Peking University · Visiting Student Research Collaborator at Princeton for one year.

projects.name: Mind Imprint
projects.summary: An AI learning platform for reading, writing, courses, and research projects, with structured thinking cards and process records.
projects.note: Public website and application entry point are live. English product branding: The Mark of Thinking.

zh.summary: 支持阅读、写作、课程与研究项目的 AI 学习平台，提供结构化思维工具卡并记录学习过程。
zh.note: 官网与应用入口已上线。英文产品名称为 The Mark of Thinking。

projects.name: Knoweia
projects.summary: A course-learning application with streamed tutoring dialogue, local Python agent execution, and synchronized course progress.
projects.note: Public desktop releases; Electron frontend, Python sidecar, and FastAPI backend.

zh.summary: 课程学习应用，提供流式辅导对话、本地 Python 智能体执行与课程进度同步。

projects.name: OrgClaw
projects.summary: An agent runtime with model-provider adapters, tool execution, session memory, and a chat API.
projects.note: Public prototype code. Organizational messaging integrations are architecture plans, not verified deployed features.

zh.summary: 智能体运行时，包含模型服务适配、工具执行、会话记忆与聊天 API。

research.name: SSDataAgent
research.summary: An LLM agent fits and evaluates generators of synthetic survey data.
research.note: Research code and experiment reports; includes empirical-copula transfer and checks for record copying.

zh.note: 公开研究代码与实验报告，包含经验 copula 迁移和记录复制检查。

research.name: Opinion correlation
research.summary: Compares associations among nine policy opinions in surveys and social media across the US, Europe, and China.
research.note: Pairwise correlations, semantic similarity, and effective dimensionality. Public analysis code.

zh.note: 方法包括两两相关、语义相似度与有效维度。分析代码已公开。
